policy.title: BYOK

enabled.label: Allow connections
enabled.description: Users can connect providers with their own API keys, billed by the provider. Turning this off disables every user provider immediately.

maxPerUser.label: Provider limit
maxPerUser.description: Providers each user can add, from 1 to 50.

blockedHosts.label: Blocked domains
blockedHosts.description: One per line, matched exactly; *.example.com matches all of its subdomains. Applies to existing providers immediately.

policy.securityNote: Only public HTTPS addresses are allowed; private, local and cloud-metadata addresses are always refused, and redirects are not followed. API keys are encrypted and hidden from administrators.

list.title: Providers
list.selectedCount: {count, plural, one {the selected provider} other {the # selected providers}}

confirm.suspendDescription: {name} will stop working immediately and can’t be re-enabled by the user.
confirm.suspendHostDescription: All providers on {host} will be blocked. To prevent new ones, also add it to blocked domains.
confirm.deleteDescription: {name} and its API key will be deleted. This can’t be undone.

toasts.affected: {count, plural, one {# provider updated} other {# providers updated}}
